title: 50THip☆Hop
altText: Epic cyberpunk DJ graffiti mural by Italian artist Mr Blob at The Bushwick Collective in Brooklyn, New York, featuring a futuristic character with neon headphones scratching a giant vinyl record.
description: Created in Brooklyn in 2023, this mural officially celebrates the 50th anniversary of Hip Hop, paying tribute to all of its disciplines. The main character of the artwork replicates the exact same character I designed for that year's official event logo, shifting its energy from the graphic space to the urban facade.
